description: Six original graphite and watercolor studies for the IAVSE about page.
prompt: Six equal panels on ivory paper in a 3 by 2 contact sheet. Graphite contours, pencil construction lines, selective seafoam, indigo, ochre and burnt orange washes. Desk lamp and ruler, vintage keyboard, sketchbook and pencil, window and trailing plant, isometric gallery, books with ink bottle and fountain pen. Tactile artisan rendering, no text or captions.
